_comment: Source of truth for the ElevenLabs agent's non-prompt config. The agent object itself is created once via the ElevenLabs dashboard; scripts/sync-agent.ts PATCHes it to match this file on every push to main. Run `npm run sync-agent:check` to validate the payload without calling the API. Run `npm run sync-agent:check` to validate the payload without calling the API.

language._why: Speaker in the architecture diagram is explicitly English + Arabic. Auto-detect/multi-language over locking to English-only, since misdetecting an Arabic-accented English caller as needing translation (or vice versa) is worse than the small added latency.

asr._why: ElevenLabs' native Scribe ASR — no custom/bolted-on STT layer, per TECH-SPEC's decision to avoid an extra round-trip inside the real-time loop.

llm._why: Placeholder — use whatever low-latency conversational model ElevenLabs currently recommends for real-time agents (Turbo-class). Confirm against current dashboard options before first sync.

turn_taking._why: Non-native/accented speakers pause mid-sentence more than the default VAD assumes. Loosening interruption sensitivity avoids cutting callers off mid-thought. Tune further against A's real questions in the 1:00-2:00 tuning pass.

_pronunciation_dictionary_note: Populate with UAE service/entity names once A's content/schema.ts and content/services/*.json land — generic ASR will mangle these.
_mcp_tools_note: Left empty on purpose. Populate once C's MCP server is live with the actual tool names/schemas (expected: find_service, get_required_documents, check_eligibility). Out of scope for this skeleton pass.
